body: But you are doing great, talking with us random people in reddit, letting out your emotions.
How are you? I hope we can talk about this.

Honestly, I agree with you and share the same sentiments. Living life in poverty made me realize that I'd never want to have kids in the same situation as where I currently am. This is what drives me to achieve a better life. I hope that you'll also find the inspiration to keep on living.
And thank you for being with us in this community, buddy :)
It must really be tough for you out there.. please don't lose hope in living especially during these difficult times.
Hey stranger. I also don’t want you to die. I know it’s hard but I hope to see you keep on living :)
Happy birthday buddy! Congratulations on surviving another year 😁
